title: Spool Record
description: One record in the agent's local hash-chained offline spool. Tampering with any record breaks the HMAC chain and the server rejects the record and all subsequent ones (SR-E5). Includes shutdown and boot markers for FR14.

spool_seq.description: Strictly increasing spool sequence number. Independent of the envelope seq.

ts_mono.description: Monotonic clock reading in seconds since process start. Resistant to clock adjustments.

ts_wall.description: Wall-clock Unix timestamp at record creation.

record_type.description: Type of spool record. shutdown and boot are markers for FR14 (powered off vs outage).

content_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 of the serialised signing envelope for measurement/heartbeat/failure records. For shutdown, SHA-256 of the literal UTF-8 bytes 'SHUTDOWN'. For boot, SHA-256 of the boot_id string bytes.

prev_spool_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 of the previous spool record's canonical bytes. For the very first record, SHA-256 of the device certificate DER bytes.

hmac.description: Base64url-encoded HMAC-SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical record with this field omitted, keyed with the device's Ed25519 private key bytes.
